description: EMS - Incidents by Month is published by City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The monthly table counts EMS assistance requests by location and incident priority. Its stated coverage is Austin and Travis County, Texas, United States; monthly aggregates. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain. The provider requests a citation and distinguishes city, county and other incidents. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
